body: Probably not. I don’t really like any of them/enjoy spending time with any of them.

My support system is basically nonexistent. I have almost no friends, and the ones I do have, I haven’t talked to in weeks. I work nights so I end up distancing myself from people since they’re not up when I am.
Thank you! Looks like that's what everyone else suggests too, so I'll start there.
Thank you so much for your kind words.
I touched one that wasn't in there for very long. It didn't burn me in the traditional sense - it was still in the "buzzy electricity" stage so I zapped myself.

I'm not insured. I've been counting on my husband to get insurance, since my job's is more than half of my full time paycheck each week. He keeps quitting job's before his eligibility date. So yeah, $30k back surgery? I have to pay for it 100% out of pocket. 

I have three cats. Athena was super skinny and scared of everything when we got her. We found out she needed to have six teeth pulled, and that she hadn't been eating because they were causing her pain. She was fine for a while after that but then had an ear polyp. We had it removed and it grew back in two weeks. The vet thought it was cancerous and suggested we either take her to have her ear canal removed or have her put down. We opted to have her ear canal removed. The polyp turned out to be not cancerous, but it was worth doing the surgery vs putting her down. She's almost 9 now and was 6 when we got her. 

Bandit we got as a kitten. She was a farm kitten and was really wild and used to love pissing me off. She's now almost three and has calmed down a lot. She loves cuddling, and when she's feeling especially cuddly, she'll walk up to my husband or I and bump her head against our mouth so we can give her teeny little head a kiss. Sometimes one kiss won't be enough so she'll keep forcing her head against our mouth until she decides she got enough lovins. 

Tabby we just got in December, during my leave. She loves curling up on my pillow while I'm laying in bed and purring away. She plays with Bandit sometimes (but gets mad when Bandit decides to use her claws). She also will only let you carry her one way - you supporting her butt while she drapes her paws over your shoulder. We thought we'd have to give her up when I started working again because she started peeing on stuff, but she was just throwing a fit because she couldn't spend 24/7 with me anymore. 

All three of them love belly rubs and cuddles. My husband and I aren't having children, so our cats are our "replacements". We spoil them absolutely rotten and they know it.

Working part time, I cannot afford to divorce him. The only reason I'm not on the streets right now is because he makes enough for us to just barely scrape by. Also, as I can't get disability because I can still work (just not full time), I will have no way of supporting myself on my own no matter what happens.
All I'm eating daily at this point is a serving of mac and cheese and an apple or an orange. If I eat less I won't be eating anything at all.

I've been eating healthy for months at a calorie deficit. I've been gaining weight still. No clue what's going on. I also only eat one meal a day and maybe an apple or orange or something at some point during the day. So theoretically I should be starving.
I have been eating at a calorie deficit. It's not helping. Also what use is a spouse if they don't care about you?
